question: Which government initiative primarily focuses on improving learning outcomes and digital literacy in schools across India?
option_3: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan
solution_text:
The correct answer is PM eVIDYA.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• PM eVIDYA was launched in 2020 as part of the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan to unify all digital, online and on-air education efforts (पीएम ई-विद्या — डिजिटल शिक्षा पहल).

• It aims to enable multi-mode access to education and improve learning outcomes and digital literacy for students.

• It includes the DIKSHA platform, One Nation One Digital Platform, and dedicated Swayam Prabha TV channels (one class, one channel).

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

Additional Information

• PM eVIDYA is implemented by the Ministry of Education.

• It was expanded to 200 TV channels under later budget announcements to support supplementary teaching.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Swachh Bharat Abhiyan is a cleanliness and sanitation mission, not an education initiative.

• opt (Option 2): Digital India Mission focuses broadly on digital infrastructure and governance, not specifically school learning outcomes.

• opt (Option 3): PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan is for integrated infrastructure and logistics connectivity.

question: Which of the following witness types is formally recognized in the BSA, 2023?
option_4: Expert witnesses such as forensic analysts
solution_text:
The correct answer is Expert witnesses such as forensic analysts.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), 2023 replaced the Indian Evidence Act, 1872 (भारतीय साक्ष्य अधिनियम — साक्ष्य कानून).

• It formally recognises the opinion of experts, including forensic analysts, as relevant evidence.

• Expert evidence covers fields like handwriting, fingerprints, forensic science and digital records.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

Additional Information

• BSA, 2023 came into effect on 1 July 2024 along with the BNS and BNSS.

• It places greater emphasis on electronic and digital records as admissible evidence.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Political representatives are not a recognised evidentiary witness category.

• opt (Option 2): Character evidence is limited and is not the only recognised witness type.

• opt (Option 3): Mythological witnesses are not a legal category of evidence.

question: The Vindhyan system of rocks is known for the production of which of the following?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Limestones.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The Vindhyan system consists of ancient sedimentary rocks and is famous for building materials like limestone and sandstone (चूना पत्थर — भवन निर्माण सामग्री).

• The red sandstone of the Vindhyan system was used to build monuments such as the Red Fort and Sanchi Stupa.

• It is largely devoid of metallic minerals and fossils.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• The Vindhyan system extends over Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan and Bihar.

• The famous Panna and Golconda diamond-bearing areas are associated with the Vindhyan system.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Manganese is associated with the Dharwar rock system.

• opt (Option 2): Coal and iron ore are chiefly found in Gondwana and Dharwar systems respectively.

• opt (Option 4): Bauxite deposits are linked with laterite and Deccan trap regions, not Vindhyan.

question: Which Kodava harvest festival, celebrated with chants of “Poli, Poli, Deva” and a ceremonial paddy harvest, invokes Lord Iguthappa?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Puthari.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Puthari is the harvest festival of the Kodava (Coorg) community of Karnataka (पुथरी — कोडवा फसल उत्सव).

• It is celebrated with chants of “Poli, Poli, Deva” and a ceremonial cutting of the first paddy.

• The festival invokes Lord Iguthappa, an important deity of the Kodavas.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• Puthari usually falls in late November or early December.

• It is a community festival marked by folk dances and shared feasts.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Kambala is a traditional buffalo race of coastal Karnataka, not a harvest festival.

• opt (Option 2): Kailpodh is a Kodava festival honouring weapons, not the paddy harvest.

• opt (Option 4): Onam is the harvest festival of Kerala, associated with King Mahabali.

question:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct options:
Assertion (A): The sculptures of the Nalanda School are three-dimensional and delicately ornamented.
Reason (R): The Nalanda sculptural tradition was influenced by Sarnath, local Bihar styles, and central Indian art.
option_1: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
option_2: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_3: A is true, but R is false.
option_4: A is false, but R is true.
solution_text:
The correct answer is Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Nalanda School sculptures, mostly in bronze and stone, are known for their three-dimensional modelling and delicate ornamentation (नालंदा कला शैली — मूर्तिकला परंपरा).

• This refined quality developed because the tradition absorbed influences from the Sarnath (Gupta) school, local Bihar styles and central Indian art.

• Hence R correctly explains why the Nalanda sculptures acquired their distinctive features.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

• Nalanda was a major centre of Buddhist art and learning under the Pala dynasty.

• The Nalanda bronzes influenced the art of Southeast Asia and Tibet.

NOTE

• opt (Option 2): R is not merely a co-occurring fact; it directly explains A, so this is wrong.

• opt (Option 3): R is factually true, so this option is incorrect.

• opt (Option 4): A is true, so this option is incorrect.

question: In Buddhist teachings, what does the term metta primarily refer to?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Fellow feeling.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Metta is a Pali term meaning loving-kindness, benevolence or fellow feeling toward all beings (मैत्री — मेत्ता, प्रेम-करुणा भावना).

• It is the first of the four Brahmaviharas (sublime states) in Buddhism.

• The Metta Bhavana is a meditation practice for cultivating universal goodwill.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• The four Brahmaviharas are Metta (loving-kindness), Karuna (compassion), Mudita (sympathetic joy) and Upekkha (equanimity).

• Metta is central to the Buddhist ideal of non-harm and compassion.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Mindful meditation corresponds to sati/vipassana, not metta.

• opt (Option 2): Ritual purity is not the meaning of metta.

• opt (Option 4): Celibacy and renunciation relate to brahmacharya, not metta.

question: What is the standard height of a football goal post?
solution_text:
The correct answer is 2.44 m.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• As per FIFA Laws of the Game, the standard height of a football goal is 2.44 metres (8 feet) (गोल पोस्ट की ऊँचाई — 2.44 मीटर).

• The distance between the two goal posts (width) is 7.32 metres (8 yards).

• These dimensions are measured from the inside edges of the posts and crossbar.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

• The goalposts and crossbar must be white in colour.

• A standard football field measures 100–110 m in length and 64–75 m in width for international matches.

NOTE

• opt (Option 2): 3.66 m does not correspond to any standard football goal dimension.

• opt (Option 3): 1.99 m is less than the standard goal height.

• opt (Option 4): 3.54 m is not a recognised football goal measurement.

question:
Fill in the blank:
The Federal Court of India, as provided under the Government of India Act 1935, was established in the year ___.
solution_text:
The correct answer is 1937.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The Federal Court of India was established in 1937 under the Government of India Act, 1935 (संघीय न्यायालय — भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1935).

• It began functioning on 1 October 1937 in Delhi.

• It had jurisdiction over disputes between the Centre and provinces and heard appeals from High Courts.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Additional Information

• The first Chief Justice of the Federal Court was Sir Maurice Gwyer.

• The Federal Court was replaced by the Supreme Court of India on 28 January 1950.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): 1936 is one year before the court actually came into being.

• opt (Option 3): 1939 is incorrect; the court was already functioning by then.

• opt (Option 4): 1942 is unrelated to the establishment of the Federal Court.

question: Which one of the following statements accurately describes a feature of the Vijayanagara Empire?
option_1: The Hazara Rama temple was a public temple for commoners.
option_2: The Lotus Mahal shows clear Persian(indo-islamic) architectural influence.
option_3: The Mahanavami Dibba is topped by a stone super-structure.
option_4: The city’s sacred centre lay north of the Tungabhadra.
solution_text:
The correct answer is The Lotus Mahal shows clear Persian(indo-islamic) architectural influence.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The Lotus Mahal in Hampi blends Hindu and Indo-Islamic (Persian) architectural styles with its arches and domes (कमल महल — इंडो-इस्लामिक वास्तुकला).

• It is located in the royal (zenana) enclosure of Vijayanagara.

• It reflects the syncretic architecture patronised by the Vijayanagara rulers.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Additional Information

• Vijayanagara Empire was founded in 1336 by Harihara and Bukka of the Sangama dynasty.

• Hampi, its capital, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): The Hazara Rama temple was a private temple of the royal family, not for commoners.

• opt (Option 3): The Mahanavami Dibba is a massive stone platform, not topped by a stone super-structure.

• opt (Option 4): The sacred centre lay along the southern bank of the Tungabhadra, not to the north.

question: Which of the following is true about relay races?
option_1: A relay team has 6 members, with 4 running members.
option_2: The baton exchange zone is 50 meters long.
option_3: The baton must weigh exactly 100 grams.
option_4: The length of the baton is 10-12 cm.
solution_text:
The correct answer is A relay team has 6 members, with 4 running members.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• In athletics relays, a team may register up to 6 athletes, of whom 4 actually run and 2 act as substitutes (रिले टीम — 6 सदस्य, 4 धावक).

• The relay is run by four runners who pass a baton within a designated exchange zone.

• Substitutes may be used between rounds of a competition.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

• Common relay events are the 4×100 m and 4×400 m.

• The baton must be passed within the take-over (exchange) zone, else the team is disqualified.

NOTE

• opt (Option 2): The baton exchange zone is 30 metres long, not 50 metres.

• opt (Option 3): A baton must weigh at least 50 grams, not exactly 100 grams.

• opt (Option 4): The baton length is about 28–30 cm, not 10–12 cm.

question: Which of the following best reflects the evolved focus of the India-US Exercise Tiger Triumph 2025 compared to its 2019 debut?
solution_text:
The correct answer is HADR + logistics via LEMOA.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Tiger Triumph is a bilateral tri-services exercise between India and the USA focused on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) (टाइगर ट्रायम्फ — मानवीय सहायता एवं आपदा राहत अभ्यास).

• The 2025 edition expanded its scope to include logistics coordination facilitated by the LEMOA agreement.

• It continues to strengthen interoperability of the two navies, armies and air forces.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• Tiger Triumph debuted in 2019 off the coast of Visakhapatnam.

• LEMOA (Logistics Exchange Memorandum of Agreement) was signed in 2016 for mutual logistics support.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): The exercise did not shift to space combat; it remained HADR-centred.

• opt (Option 2): It retained amphibious drills rather than prioritising cyber ops.

• opt (Option 4): It retained, and did not drop, the tri-service format.

question: What is the primary literary significance of the book 'Bonkers!' by Natasha Sharma?
option_1: Known as a memoir of rural life
option_2: Known as a historical epic on colonial India
option_3: Known for experimental style and social themes
option_4: Known as a science fiction on future societies
solution_text:
The correct answer is Known for experimental style and social themes.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• 'Bonkers!' by Natasha Sharma is noted for its experimental, playful storytelling style and its engagement with social themes (बोंकर्स — प्रयोगात्मक शैली की पुस्तक).

• Natasha Sharma is a well-known Indian children's author.

• Her works blend humour with meaningful social messages for young readers.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• Natasha Sharma has won the Bal Sahitya Puraskar for her contribution to children's literature.

• She is known for the 'History Mystery' series among other titles.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): It is not a memoir of rural life.

• opt (Option 2): It is not a historical epic on colonial India.

• opt (Option 4): It is not a science fiction on future societies.

question: Which Union Minister officially announced that the Khelo India University Games 2025 will be held in Rajasthan this November?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Mansukh Mandaviya.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Mansukh Mandaviya, the Union Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports, announced that the Khelo India University Games 2025 would be held in Rajasthan (मनसुख मंडाविया — युवा मामले एवं खेल मंत्री).

• Khelo India University Games is a national multi-sport event for university athletes.

• The initiative promotes grassroots sports talent under the Khelo India programme.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

• Mansukh Mandaviya also holds the Labour and Employment portfolio.

• The Khelo India programme was launched in 2018 to revive sports culture in India.

NOTE

• opt (Option 2): Kiren Rijiju is currently the Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs.

• opt (Option 3): Anurag Thakur is a former Sports Minister but did not make this announcement.

• opt (Option 4): Nitin Gadkari is the Minister of Road Transport and Highways.

question:
Which is/ are correct about the first Asian Games held in 1951?
A) Held at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium with 12 nations.
B) Japan topped the medals, India was second; venue was National Stadium, Delhi.
option_3: Both A and B are correct
option_4: Neither A nor B are Correct
solution_text:
The correct answer is Only B is correct.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The first Asian Games were held in New Delhi in 1951 at the National Stadium (now Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium) (प्रथम एशियाई खेल — राष्ट्रीय स्टेडियम, दिल्ली).

• Japan topped the medal tally while India finished second, making statement B correct.

• Statement A is wrong because the venue was the National Stadium (not Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium) and 11 nations participated.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Additional Information

• The 1951 Asian Games were inaugurated by President Dr. Rajendra Prasad.

• The Asian Games are held every four years under the Olympic Council of Asia.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Statement A is incorrect regarding venue and number of nations, so 'Only A' is wrong.

• opt (Option 3): Since A is incorrect, both cannot be correct.

• opt (Option 4): Statement B is correct, so 'Neither' is wrong.

question:
Fill in the blanks:
The _____ List in Schedule VII deals solely with matters of national importance like defence and foreign affairs.
solution_text:
The correct answer is Union.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The Union List in the Seventh Schedule contains subjects of national importance such as defence and foreign affairs (संघ सूची — राष्ट्रीय महत्व के विषय).

• Only Parliament can make laws on subjects in the Union List.

• It originally contained 97 subjects.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

• The Seventh Schedule has three lists – Union, State and Concurrent.

• Residuary powers (subjects not in any list) rest with the Union under Article 248.

NOTE

• opt (Option 2): The State List covers subjects of local/state importance like police and public health.

• opt (Option 3): The Concurrent List has subjects on which both Centre and States can legislate.

• opt (Option 4): 'Residuary' is not a separate list in Schedule VII.

question: Why is generative-design software used in launch vehicle (LV) structural engineering?
option_1: To increase the mass of structural components
option_2: To reduce structural weight while maintaining performance
option_3: To simplify 2D CAD drafting in mission drawings
option_4: To boost overall mission cost through advanced algorithms
solution_text:
The correct answer is To reduce structural weight while maintaining performance.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Generative-design software uses algorithms to optimise geometry, reducing structural weight while retaining strength and performance (जनरेटिव डिज़ाइन — भार-अनुकूलन सॉफ्टवेयर).

• Lighter launch vehicle structures improve the payload-to-weight ratio and fuel efficiency.

• It explores many design options automatically to find the most efficient structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Additional Information

• Generative design is widely used in aerospace to create lightweight, high-strength lattice components.

• It is often combined with additive manufacturing (3D printing) for complex parts.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): The aim is to reduce, not increase, mass of components.

• opt (Option 3): It goes far beyond simple 2D CAD drafting, generating optimised 3D forms.

• opt (Option 4): It aims to lower mission cost, not increase it.

question:
Which of the following statements regarding State Funds under the Indian Constitution is/are correct?
1) The Consolidated Fund of the State is defined under Article 266.
2) The Contingency Fund of the State is operated by the Governor in accordance with rules made by the State Legislature.
solution_text:
The correct answer is Both 1 and 2.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Article 266 defines both the Consolidated Fund of India and of the States, so statement 1 is correct (संचित निधि — अनुच्छेद 266).

• The Contingency Fund of the State, under Article 267, is placed at the disposal of the Governor to meet unforeseen expenditure, as per rules made by the State Legislature, so statement 2 is correct.

• Both funds are therefore correctly described.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• The Contingency Fund of India is at the disposal of the President under Article 267.

• Withdrawals from the Consolidated Fund require legislative authorisation.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): 'Only 1' is wrong because statement 2 is also correct.

• opt (Option 2): 'Only 2' is wrong because statement 1 is also correct.

• opt (Option 4): 'Neither' is wrong because both statements are correct.

question: Why is it more difficult to walk on sand than on a concrete pavement?
option_1: Sand has a higher coefficient of static friction than concrete.
option_2: Sand is less dense than concrete, causing less gravitational pull.
option_4: Sand particles are magnetic, creating an opposing force.
solution_text:
The correct answer is Sand displaces, reducing pushback.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Sand grains shift and displace under the foot, so it cannot provide a firm reaction (pushback) force (न्यूटन का तीसरा नियम — क्रिया-प्रतिक्रिया).

• On concrete the surface is rigid and pushes back fully by Newton's third law, making walking easy.

• On sand, part of the effort is wasted in displacing grains, so more energy is needed to move forward.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• Walking depends on friction and the normal reaction from the ground.

• Loose, granular surfaces reduce effective grip and reaction force.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Sand actually provides a less firm reaction, not a higher usable static friction, so this is not the reason.

• opt (Option 2): Reduced density does not meaningfully change gravitational pull on the walker.

• opt (Option 4): Sand particles are not magnetic and do not create an opposing magnetic force.

question: dance form Ka Shad Suk Mynsiem is a thanks giving dance of which community?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Khasi.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Ka Shad Suk Mynsiem is a thanksgiving dance of the Khasi community of Meghalaya (खासी समुदाय — मेघालय का जनजातीय नृत्य).

• Its name means 'dance of the joyful heart' and it is performed to thank God and Mother Nature for a good harvest.

• Unmarried men and women participate in traditional attire.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

• The festival is usually held in April at Shillong.

• It reflects the Khasi indigenous faith and cultural heritage.

NOTE

• opt (Option 2): The Ao are a Naga tribe of Nagaland, associated with the Moatsu festival.

• opt (Option 3): The Apatani are a tribe of Arunachal Pradesh known for the Dree festival.

• opt (Option 4): The Adi are an Arunachal Pradesh tribe known for the Solung festival.

question:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct options:
Assertion (A): The Human Development Index can increase even if income drops.
Reason (R): Improvements in life expectancy and education can offset income decline.
option_1: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
option_2: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_3: A is true, but R is false.
option_4: A is false, but R is true.
solution_text:
The correct answer is Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The Human Development Index (HDI) is a composite of three dimensions – income, health (life expectancy) and education (मानव विकास सूचकांक — समग्र सूचकांक).

• Because HDI is an average of these dimensions, gains in life expectancy and education can offset a fall in income, so A is true.

• R explains exactly why HDI can rise despite lower income, so R is the correct explanation of A.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

• HDI was introduced by the UNDP in 1990, conceptualised by Mahbub ul Haq and Amartya Sen.

• HDI values range from 0 to 1, with higher values indicating better human development.

NOTE

• opt (Option 2): R does explain A, so this option is incorrect.

• opt (Option 3): R is true, so this option is wrong.

• opt (Option 4): A is true, so this option is wrong.

question:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct option:
Assertion (A): In macroeconomics, treating a single commodity as representative of all goods allows simplification of aggregate analysis.
Reason (R): This is because all individual goods always behave identically under inflationary trends.
option_1: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
option_2: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_3: A is true, but R is false.
option_4: A is false, but R is true.
solution_text:
The correct answer is A is true, but R is false.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Macroeconomics often uses a single representative commodity to simplify aggregate analysis, so A is true (समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र — प्रातिनिधिक वस्तु).

• However, it is not true that all individual goods always behave identically under inflation – different goods have different price behaviour, so R is false.

• The simplification is an analytical assumption, not a claim that all goods behave the same.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• The 'representative agent' and 'representative commodity' are common simplifying tools in macro modelling.

• Relative prices of goods change differently even during general inflation.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): R is false, so this option is wrong.

• opt (Option 2): R is false, so 'both true' is incorrect.

• opt (Option 4): A is true, so this option is wrong.

question: What was the primary aim of import substitution policy in India's early planning era?
option_3: Replace foreign imports with domestic production
solution_text:
The correct answer is Replace foreign imports with domestic production.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Import Substitution Industrialisation (ISI) aimed to replace imported goods with domestically produced ones to achieve self-reliance (आयात प्रतिस्थापन — आत्मनिर्भरता).

• It was a key strategy of India's early Five Year Plans, especially the Second Plan.

• Domestic industries were protected through high tariffs and import restrictions.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• The strategy was influenced by the Mahalanobis model emphasising heavy industry.

• India shifted away from import substitution toward liberalisation after the 1991 reforms.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Export-led industrialisation is the opposite outward-oriented strategy.

• opt (Option 2): Attracting foreign capital was not the primary aim of ISI.

• opt (Option 4): Liberalising trade barriers contradicts the protectionist nature of ISI.

question: Which of the following correctly describes a heavy industry?
option_1: It uses light raw materials like cotton.
option_3: Uses bulky inputs to produce heavy goods.
solution_text:
The correct answer is Uses bulky inputs to produce heavy goods.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• A heavy industry uses large, bulky raw materials and produces heavy, large-scale products (भारी उद्योग — विशाल कच्चा माल एवं उत्पाद).

• Examples include iron and steel, shipbuilding, heavy machinery and cement industries.

• Such industries require large capital investment and infrastructure.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• Heavy industries are often located near sources of raw materials to reduce transport costs.

• They form the base for the growth of many downstream light industries.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Using light raw materials like cotton is a feature of light industry.

• opt (Option 2): Producing light consumer goods describes light industry.

• opt (Option 4): Manufacturing cosmetics and toiletries is a light/consumer industry.

question:
Consider the following statements on the PRITHvi Vigyan Mission:
1. It aims to unify ocean, weather, and geoscience observations.
2. It supports India's early warning systems for tsunamis and cyclones.
3. It was launched by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
solution_text:
The correct answer is Only 1 and 2 are correct.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The PRITHvi (PRITHVI) Vigyan Mission aims to unify ocean, atmosphere (weather), climate and geoscience observations, so statement 1 is correct (पृथ्वी विज्ञान मिशन — पृथ्वी विज्ञान मंत्रालय).

• It supports early warning systems for tsunamis, cyclones and other hazards, so statement 2 is correct.

• It was launched by the Ministry of Earth Sciences, not the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, so statement 3 is wrong.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

• The PRITHVI scheme was approved by the Union Cabinet in 2024 for 2021–26.

• It integrates five sub-schemes covering atmosphere, ocean, cryosphere, seismology and capacity building.

NOTE

• opt (Option 2): It includes statement 3, which wrongly attributes the mission to the Health Ministry.

• opt (Option 3): It includes the wrong statement 3, so it is incorrect.

• opt (Option 4): 'All three' is wrong because statement 3 is false.

question: Which international organizations played a crucial role in triggering the 1991 economic reforms in India?
solution_text:
The correct answer is World Bank and IMF.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The 1991 economic reforms were triggered amid a balance of payments crisis, when India sought assistance from the IMF and World Bank (अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मुद्रा कोष एवं विश्व बैंक — आर्थिक सुधार).

• Their conditions (structural adjustment) pushed India toward Liberalisation, Privatisation and Globalisation (LPG).

• The reforms were introduced under P. V. Narasimha Rao's government with Dr. Manmohan Singh as Finance Minister.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Additional Information

• India pledged gold to raise foreign exchange during the 1991 crisis.

• The New Economic Policy of 1991 marked a major shift from a controlled to a market-oriented economy.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): The UN and WHO deal with global cooperation and health, not economic bailouts.

• opt (Option 3): WTO (formed 1995) did not exist in 1991, and UNESCO deals with education/culture.

• opt (Option 4): ADB provides development finance but was not the key trigger; WTO did not yet exist.
